description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Realizar exames ultrassonográficos em pacientes externos ou internos, atendendo as solicitações da Unidade.

Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Registro ativo no conselho de classe

RQE em Radiologia Médica ou Ultrassonografia

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função

Hospital localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ

Strategic yet detail-oriented, able to navigate complex business and technical challenges while keeping the big picture and growth goals in focus.

Curious, ambitious, and test-driven mindset, with genuine interest in continuous learning, experimentation, and leveraging AI or emerging technologies.

title: Engineering Performance Analyst
description:
Engineering Performance Analyst

Location : Hyderabad, IN

Employment type : Employee Place of work : Office Offshore / Onshore : Onshore

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Engineering Performance Analyst is responsible for analyzing the Engineering Performance data on a regular basis, detect trends, check for issues and issue warnings and recommendations to the One Engineering management, both at a global One Engineering level as at Project, Package or Sub-system level when required.

The overall purpose of the Engineering Performance Analyst is to contribute to improvement of the Engineering Performance. To achieve that to :

  • Analyze, understand and discuss key engineering performance indicators and associated trends (schedule, progress, on time delivery, manhours (actuals, budget and forecast), risk and quality).
  • Support Eng Performance Director in issuing guidance and recommendation for improvement of Eng Performance to OE LT.
  • Advise and guide PEM’s and PKM, SSLE in the management of the Engineering of Specific Projects or packages requiring support.
  • Defining and sharing best practices and lessons learned in the domain of Eng Performance Analysis across PEM, SSLE, Planning, Cost Control, PCM population across Subsea

Key Missions and Responsibilities

  • Perform analysis of Engineering Management and Engineering Performance Data and KPI’s covering the following indicators : Schedules and delivery according to schedule (base line or reforecast) or not (OTD / ADL), Progress booked
  • Manhours and cost spent and comparison with budget, forecasts, EAC.
  • Link between Progress and manhours spent (e.g. ECR and MOC affecting the engineering scope)
  • Engineering or technical risks and relation to Value destruction
  • Quality or quality gaps of Engineering project deliverables
  • Other indicators as available and / or judged relevant
  • Integrate additional sources of data (e.g. technology maturity levels, project organizations etc.. to develop better prediction of risk indicators to allow prediction of deviation from target KPIs.
  • Develop and Analysis guidelines, best practices, check list to help SSLEs, PEMs, Eng Dept Managers to analysis the data on their projects and draw the right conclusions and issues. Both based on analysis of life projects and post mortem analysis of completed projects.
  • Work closely with “Eng Performance data programmers” to highlight data quality issues, additional data tracking and visualization needs, improvement opportunities. Guide them in development of adequate data gathering tools and visualization.
  • Work closely with Engineering Department managers, to support them on the analysis of the performance of their teams and in drawing learning from these analyses.
  • Work closely with project PEMs and SSLE, to support them on the analysis of the performance of their teams and in drawing learning from these analyses when requested to specific lay support a given project based on Eng Performance Director request.
  • Have good overall knowledge of the TechnipFMC Engineering Management and project control processes and evolution of those changes
  • Lead by example and demonstrate commitment to Safety and Quality through actively driving the correct behaviors (in line with Core Values)
  • Continuously keep updated regarding the latest evolutions in project engineering activities and targets and objectives

You are meant for this job if :

Must have :

  • More than 10 years of Technical or Project experience, 8+ years in subsea
  • Good understanding of Engineering Activities on an iEPCI project
  • Detailed understanding of Project Controls process and data acquisition system
  • Good understanding of REMS organization and ways of working
  • Working knowledge of SAP, Power BI, Excel
  • Be able to establish deadlines and manage priorities for self and others.
  • Negotiate technical solutions with client.

Recommended formal education :

  • Technical or Economics / Business degree

Required personal skills :

  • Analytical skills and rigor
  • Interest in analytical work and working with numbers
  • Good communication skills both with local and remote colleagues.
  • Ability to Work in teams
  • Good knowledge of English language, both verbally and written
  • Ability to work within a global environment

Performs well in a fast paced atmosphere, and constantly changing schedules and priorities.

Skills

Data Analysis, Analytical Skills, Analysis and Problem Solving, Root Cause Analysis and Corrective / Preventive Action

We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matter and we encourage you to add to our culture.

title: College Research Administration Manager
description:
Join to apply for the College Research Administration Manager role at Howard University .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre- and post-award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature and Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre-award and post-award support. This position reports primarily to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance. A dotted-line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research ensures alignment with the day-to-day priorities of the assigned college. The incumbent will serve as a bridge between central oversight and college-specific needs, ensuring the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre-Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post-Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university-wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi-tasking in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization, strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a busy, high-volume, and deadline-driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency request.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders, excellent customer service skills, and outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Incumbents must be able to write and interpret technical contract language, understand its implications, and effectively communicate with and serve as liaisons between granting agencies, University administration, and the principal investigators.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA, BBA, or BS (foreign equivalent or higher) in Business, Finance, Accounting, or other related fields and 5 years of professional experience in research administration.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Advanced knowledge of federal, state, and local regulations governing sponsored research, including Uniform Guidance and FAR clauses.
  • Excellent communication skills, including conveying complex concepts to non-specialist audiences.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in research administration systems (e.g., Cayuse, Workday).

Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions and perform any other related duties as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description cannot be construed as a contract for employment.

title: Analista de Informações Operacionais Jr Rio de Janeiro - RJ and Hybrid Full-time employee
description:
Job description

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

Main responsibilities

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Informações Operacionais Júnior para atuar em análises, acompanhamento de indicadores e apoio aos processos regulatórios e financeiros ligados aos produtos de seguros da companhia.

Quais serão os seus desafios:

  • Realizar o acompanhamento do reajuste anual das contribuições de seguros, entendendo impactos, cálculos e regras aplicáveis;
  • Garantir o correto entendimento e análise dos produtos de seguros, considerando suas particularidades, composições e diferenças estruturais;
  • Acompanhamento de KPIs e variáveis de controle;
  • Levantamento e análise de comportamentos atípicos;
  • Elaboração de justificativas técnicas;
  • Questionamento crítico sobre números e resultados;
  • Interface constante com o time financeiro, garantindo que os prêmios emitidos estejam de acordo com o previsto e colaborando para correções e justificativas quando necessário;
  • Atuar no batimento das bases de dados, relacionadas às inscrições dos planos instituídos e de previdência pública, entre a MAG e os Parceiros;
  • Acompanhar a execução automática da rotina de cancelamento e atraso, com base nas regras definidas pela Política de Operações;
  • Trazer insights e análises a partir da interpretação de dados (prêmios, apropriações, valores emitidos etc.);
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA para ganho de escala, automação e otimização de atividades;
  • Preparar apresentações, relatórios e explicações claras sobre análises realizadas.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação preferencialmente nas áreas de Atuarial, Estatística, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de explicar análises complexas de forma clara;
  • Raciocínio analítico e habilidade para interpretação de dados;
  • Interesse e/ou uso básico de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em Python para automações e análises;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI;
  • Experiência prévia com Lean (gerenciamento diário/KPI) é um diferencial.

Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.

Sobre a CBO:

Somos a segunda maior empresa, em número de embarcações, do Brasil, no segmento offshore, com mais de 40 anos de tradição, inovação e pioneirismo.

Nossos principais valores são segurança, sustentabilidade, integridade, atendimento, resultado, inovação e gente. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão, e buscamos criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e seguro para todas e todos. Temos como estratégia a contratação de pessoas com deficiência e outros públicos diversos, como mulheres, negros, e o público LGBTQIA+.

Descrição da Resumida:

Nesse papel, você será responsável por apoiar a operação marítima garantindo que as equipes embarcadas tenham condições seguras de trabalho, atuando em toda a cadeia de prevenção, controle e resposta a emergências.

Principais Atividades

  • Atuar como Responsável Técnica (RT) da companhia, representando a empresa junto ao CRN, Anvisa e demais órgãos reguladores.
  • Elaborar e atualizar manuais, POPs, fluxos, procedimentos e políticas de segurança alimentar e sanitária para toda a frota.
  • Realizar auditorias sanitárias internas a bordo das embarcações, registrando evidências, não conformidades e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Acompanhar auditorias sanitárias de clientes e autoridades , garantindo conformidade e suporte técnico.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos e capacitações (onshore e offshore) sobre Boas Práticas, higiene, manipulação de alimentos e padrões sanitários.
  • Participar da implementação do projeto “Bordo Digital” , transformando checklists, formulários e registros técnicos em processos digitais.
  • Realizar análise e tratamento de não conformidades , incluindo elaboração de relatórios, definição de planos de ação e acompanhamento das tratativas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de segurança sanitária (KPIs) , avaliando desempenho, tendências e necessidades de ajuste.
  • Acompanhar e supervisionar a consultoria especializada, garantindo execução de cronogramas, inspeções e manuais de higienização.
  • Apoiar a operação e as equipes de bordo na implementação e manutenção dos padrões sanitários exigidos por normas, clientes e legislação .
  • Contribuir para a cultura de Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente , fortalecendo práticas operacionais seguras e conformes.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Nutrição com CRN ativo ;
  • Experiência em segurança alimentar , Boas Práticas de Manipulação e inspeções sanitárias;
  • Vivência com auditorias internas e externas , elaboração de POPs, manuais e procedimentos sanitários;
  • Capacidade de conduzir treinamentos técnicos e orientar equipes operacionais;

description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Manutenção que ficará responsável pela supervisão de toda equipe de manutenção mecânica, através do acompanhamento de cada etapa dos processos existentes, indicadores de desempenho dos colaboradores, compra dos devidos equipamentos a fim de disponibilizar e garantir uma operação funcional confiável em todos os equipamentos da usina.

Main responsibilities

  • Assegurar que os processos da manutenção mecânica sejam executados de uma guisa confiável, supervisionando e executando as manutenções programadas e executadas pelos técnicos mecânicos, através do acompanhamento dos processos em questão, com o propósito de estabelecer a excelência do setor em específico;
  • Assegurar que os equipamentos e sobressalentes sejam comprados corretamente, através da especificação técnica, a fim de adquirir devidamente o maquinário que atenderá toda demanda existente;
  • Executar o plano da manutenção mecânica preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual e pela solicitação das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, a fim de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos da planta, qualidade e segurança dos mesmos;
  • Assegurar que os serviços contratados sejam executados conforme especificação, através da coordenação, acompanhamento e supervisão das tarefas efetuadas, com o intuito de atender devidamente que toda a demanda seja concretizada com eficácia e padronização;
  • Contribuir para o alcance dos objetivos, através do cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela organização, a fim de garantir a excelência de todos os processos que são realizados;
  • Avaliar o desempenho e a necessidade de treinamentos dos colaboradores, através do acompanhamento dos processos e reciclagens, com o intuito de aperfeiçoar o capital intelectual dos mesmos, garantindo resultados para a organização;
  • Obter melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, contribuindo na redução dos custos da manutenção.

description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: MÉDICO PEDIATRA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, onde estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência, Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial dos serviços oferecidos, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e tem como objetivo absorver demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e internação. Um diferencial do CER é o atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

As atividades incluem realizar consultas no Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico, unificando dados de prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; visitar pacientes internados, avaliando sua recuperação; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou especialização na área
  • Registro ativo no conselho da classe
  • RQE em Pediatria
  • Experiência em Pediatria

Carga horária: 12h semanais.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviços, com vínculo de grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou atuando em outra modalidade contratual, devem seguir as normativas de RH vigentes, consultando o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de caráter filantrópico, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde via convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão da instituição é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, focada no tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, fortalecendo vínculos com a comunidade e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos na assistência social e educação, consolidando sua posição como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

A SPDM contribui para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), garantindo universalidade e acesso à saúde, combinando tecnologia avançada com atendimento de alta qualidade por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo para outros municípios e estados. Seu objetivo é melhorar indicadores e a qualidade de vida, seguindo princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando publicações periódicas de anúncios em jornais principais de São Paulo e regiões atendidas.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com alta qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis da assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

  • Proven success in a project management capacity
  • Ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Experience working with financial data and information
  • Great people skills – high degree of empathy and great communication skills
  • Experience working with clients
  • Experience in implementing and successfully managing small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Passionate, tactical, and direct, with an ambitious attitude and a proven history to go above and beyond baseline requirements
  • Interested in working with enterprise software

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. If you are located in New York, New York, our minimum cash compensation salary range for this role is $81,000 - $85,000 (if applicable, + commission). We are hiring for multiple levels and locations, so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors.

description:
QHSES Manager, Surface UK

Location: Aberdeen, GB

Employment type: Employee Place of work: Office Offshore / Onshore: Onshore

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

In this key leadership role based in our Altens office in Aberdeen, you’ll drive Quality and HSES excellence across Surface UK operations in both Aberdeen and Dunfermline. This role is key to ensuring robust processes and systems that support our business goals and deliver outstanding results.

You’ll champion a culture of continuous improvement, inspiring the right behaviours and fostering collaboration throughout the organization. As a trusted influencer, you’ll build strong relationships while managing and developing the Quality and HSES functions in alignment with TechnipFMC’s strategy, policies, and industry standards.

If you’re passionate about safety, quality, and leadership—and want to shape the future of our operations—this is your opportunity to lead with purpose.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Culture

  • Mentor, coach, and inspire your team to build a strong Quality and HSE culture.
  • Drive QHSES awareness and continuous improvement across all UK bases.
  • Act as a trusted influencer, promoting best practices and positive behaviours.

QHSES Management

  • Implement and monitor our Business Process Management System (BPMS).
  • Ensure compliance with local, national, and international HSE regulations.
  • Develop and maintain QHSES policies and programs aligned with TechnipFMC standards.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Support initiatives like standardization and 5S.
  • Oversee Management Reviews and KPI reporting.
  • Facilitate Non-Conformance and CAPA processes.
  • Align QHSES objectives with business True North goals.

Risk & Change Management

  • Coach teams on risk assessment methodologies.
  • Promote and guide the Management of Change (MOC) process.

Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits and support regional programs.
  • Prepare for and manage external audits (certification bodies, customer audits).
  • Ensure compliance with API Q2, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and HSE legislation.

Training & Development

  • Deliver QHSES training and awareness initiatives.

Operational Support

  • Encourage proactive hazard identification and reporting.
  • Monitor environmental aspects (waste, emissions, spill prevention).
  • Review client / project documentation and support tender / bid processes.

Security & Emergency Response

  • Act as site Security focal point and emergency response team member.
  • Maintain risk assessments and crisis management plans.

Incident Management

  • Lead investigations using TapRooT, TopSet, and other recognized methodologies.
  • Conduct safety drills and behavioural safety observations.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Quality team.
  • Foster accountability, safety, and quality across all functions.
  • Support operational readiness and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

Visits to workshop and storage areas required, these environments may be noisy, dusty, subject to temperature variations depending on the season.

May be opportunities to travel to other Surface locations to attend training events, participate in audits, operational meetings.

No significant physical demands are associated with this role.

Education & Certifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Occupational Safety, or related field.
  • NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent HSE certification.
  • Lead Auditor qualification (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).

Experience

  • Proven experience in HSES, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control.
  • Energy industry background (preferred).
  • Strong PC skills (Office 365); ERP knowledge (SAP desirable).
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications.

Skills & Attributes

  • Excellent communication and coaching skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Expertise in root cause analysis and process improvement.
  • Knowledge of Lean tools and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Familiarity with ISO standards and API Q2.

Benefits

  • Competative pension scheme
  • Private medical care
  • Group Life assurance
  • Group income protenction
  • 31 days flexible annual leave + 4 public holidays
  • Hybrid working - 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
  • Onsite canteen
  • Additional non-contractual benefites such as Gymflex, Dental insurance, Cycle2work, Electric vehicle scheme and more

title: mbar Energia - Mecânico De Manutenção (Usina Termelétrica)
description:
Job description

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas térmelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);
  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);
  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;
  • Conhecimento em Hidráulica e Pneumática;
  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;
  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;
  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;
  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;
  • Interpretação de Desenho Mecânico.

No Brasil, a empresa tem sua sede localizada na cidade de Florianópolis, em Santa Catarina (SC). Atualmente controla 26 ativos de geração renovável no Brasil. Em novembro de 2023, a Statkraft assinou a compra da Enerfín, subsidiária renovável da espanhola Elecnor, que inclui nove parques eólicos em operação nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte. Dessa forma, a empresa tornou-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do Brasil, ultrapassando a marca de 2,2 GW de capacidade instalada, entre aquisições, construções e operações no país.

A empresa é pioneira em oferecer energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando, por meio do I-REC (Certificado Internacional de Energia Renovável), a origem da produção da sua energia, o que garante que a operação é sustentável.

title: Manager, Volunteer Engagement
description:
Join to apply for the Manager, Volunteer Engagement role at FIFA Women's World Cup™

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives. This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication. The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner-related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high-quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey. This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large-scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament-time. The ideal candidate understands the mindset of a volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large-scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme.
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women’s World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines.
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
  • Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament-time and post-event legacy.
  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
  • Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament’s values, brand, and legacy objectives.
  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end-to-end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end-to-end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner-related activities and tournament time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large-scale volunteer programmes.
  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large-scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS/web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity). Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil/South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations/time zones.
  • Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Sr. Full Stack Developer
description:
Overview

Sr. Software Developer

Compensation: $19-22USD / hr

Paid two week company wide closure at calendar year end.

1 week paid time off per quarter - flexibility on timing based on team requirements

1 paid Friday off monthly between February and November.

Employment type: Contractor - no additional benefits

Hours of operation: Preference between 9am-5pm EST

Our client wants you to join a startup‑to‑scaleup journey as a Senior Software Developer. In this fully remote role, you’ll work on a schedule that ensures sufficient overlap with the core working hours of the EST timezone. You’ll be part of a team building new products that will be part of our assessments platform. You’ll build new systems, maintain existing systems, lead design, and mentor developers.

The systems you’ll work in are mostly JavaScript and TypeScript, though we have some new code in Go. New apps are React UIs that call well‑defined APIs running on AWS API Gateway and Lambda and use NoSQL databases like DynamoDB.

The role is ideal for a quality‑focused full‑stack developer with strong technical proficiency who is looking to advance their career with a people‑centric company that prioritizes work‑life balance, invests in continuous growth, and builds products with meaningful social impact.

Client Overview

Our company was founded on the need for a higher education admissions method that looks beyond academic performance and considers the whole student—their unique qualities, experiences, and strengths.

Today, our solutions help discover, nurture and realize people’s potential, supporting holistic success from admissions to graduation for students, education programs, and higher education institutions across North America, the U.K., Australia, and Saudi Arabia.

Our core assessment product provides education programs with a more holistic view of applicants by evaluating their soft skills. Incorporating insights into the admissions process results in a larger applicant pool, enables student success, and graduates better professionals. Since 2014, our software has been adopted by over 600 higher education programs, and more than 1 million applicants have registered to take the test.

With our core education program management solution, we help medical schools and other health professions programs optimize the complex processes and critical components of their curriculum and student assessments to generate data‑driven insights needed to graduate competent future healthcare professionals.

With our fast‑growing data and insights solution, Analytics, we leverage critical integrations with our data warehouse and powerful dashboards to provide medical schools with deep insights and intelligence on student and program performance, powering real‑time decision‑making and continuous quality improvement.

What Skills Should You Bring?

  • 6+ years with backend JavaScript and TypeScript
  • 6+ years with Go and React
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and cloud platforms
  • Experience with AWS / MongoDB + Postgres

You need to be comfortable working on full‑stack web applications. You can change UIs, APIs, database schemas, or deployment pipelines as needed. Ideally, you’ve worked on and led large system migrations. Preferably, you’ve experienced one migration that’s gone well (so you recognize success) but also one that was challenging (so you’ve learned from mistakes).

What Will You Work On?

Our team owns multiple new products that will be part of our assessments platform. We have initial projects underway but the plan is not fully defined. As a senior‑level developer, you have opinions on design tradeoffs in this space and can articulate them in productive debates with the team, weighing short vs. long‑term impact. You’ll be the glue between leaders in Product and the rest of the development team. You’ll work directly with product managers to prioritize features and improvements. It’s essential that your technical perspective informs what’s possible. Your opinions are as strong as the data you have to defend them.

Along the way, you will help guide our quality improvements. We expect you to be familiar with techniques and processes such as pair programming, code reviews, automated testing (unit / integration / end‑to‑end), feature flagging, monitoring, and alarming. We expect that you will mentor developers to adopt the practices that meet your quality expectations. We also expect that you can articulate the limits of these approaches and know what mix to use for any given problem.

A Senior Developer must have strong written and verbal communication skills. You should have no problem discussing issues publicly on Slack, ensuring your reasoning is available to anyone when needed. Your project plans, status updates, high‑level task summaries should be clear and easy reads. You will contribute all manner of system and architecture diagrams to the wiki to ensure the whole team is aligned with your technical vision. You also know when it’s time to hop on a video call to hash something out.

You’re also adept at providing feedback. You can gauge where a developer is at and provide them with specific, actionable feedback to improve. Your commits and pull requests will set the high standard for other developers to follow. Your review comments will be written with empathy and tact where code quality could be improved to meet your professional standards.

Interview Process

Here are the steps you can expect:

  • Conversation with Recruiter – 30‑minute phone call during which you share your professional journey, career interests and assess initial skills.
  • Meet the Manager – 45‑minute video call with your potential future manager. Discuss your relevant technical work experiences and learn in‑depth about the day‑to‑day of the team and role.
  • Asynchronous Code Review – A brief take‑home project that offers you the opportunity to showcase your ability to give feedback and mentor other team members.
  • Meet the Team & Showcase Your Technical Abilities – Meet with 3 more team members, a blend of technical and non‑technical people, leaders, future peers and collaborators. You’ll meet 1‑1 in a remote setting, go through live coding and system design exercises.

This company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.

Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias.

title: Manager, Volunteer Engagement
description:
BRL 80.000 - 120.000

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives. This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication. The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner-related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.

This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high‑quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey. This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.

We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large‑scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament‑time. The ideal candidate understands mindset of volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large‑scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme,
  • Ensure alignment with FIFA Women's World Cup strategy, FIFA’s global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines
  • Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
  • Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament‑time and post‑event legacy.
  • Co‑lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
  • Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.Right to work in Brazil.
  • Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
  • Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament's values, brand, and legacy objectives.
  • Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
  • Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
  • Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
  • Oversee end‑to‑end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
  • Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end‑to‑end RFP process.
  • Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner‑related activities and tournament time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
  • Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how‑to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
  • Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross‑functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
  • Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
  • Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
  • Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large‑scale volunteer programmes.
  • University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
  • Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
  • Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
  • Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
  • Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
  • Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large‑scale communication plans.
  • Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS/web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity. Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
  • Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil/South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
  • Positive, collaborative, solutions‑driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
  • Team‑oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
  • Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations/time zones.
  • Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
  • Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

Se você tem um histórico comprovado na gestão e desenvolvimento de fornecedores de última milha e equipes de campo, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para se juntar a nós! Aqui, você terá a chance de otimizar fluxos de trabalho e usar suas habilidades analíticas para aprimorar continuamente nossos processos. Buscamos um profissional que saiba como impulsionar a eficiência operacional e o desempenho da equipe, além de ser um excelente facilitador para a colaboração interdepartamental. Se você tem experiência em gerenciar operações externas e implementar melhorias que alinhem as operações aos objetivos de negócios, queremos você em nossa equipe! Se você está pronto para fazer a diferença e crescer com a 99, esta posição é para você. Venha transformar o futuro das operações e fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora e dinâmica!

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido/Externo (Foco em visitas a parceiros + 1 dia fixo no escritório)

Sobre o Desafio

Você será a voz do campo dentro da empresa e a voz da empresa no campo.

Principais Responsabilidades

A. Gestão de Performance e Consultoria

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os donos e gestores dos Operadores Logísticos, atuando como "gestor da conta".
  • Conduzir rituais de gestão periódicos (reuniões de resultados semanais/mensais), apresentando resultados e diagnósticos de performance.
  • Desenvolver e monitorar planos de ação (PDCA) para correção de desvios de indicadores.

  • Operacionalizar a subida de escala no sistema, garantindo conformidade com o plano.

C. Inteligência e Análise de Dados

  • Monitorar diariamente os KPIs operacionais e o ciclo de vida da frota (onboarding, engajamento e churn).
  • Traduzir dados brutos de dashboards em insights de negócio para orientar a tomada de decisão do OL.

Role Qualifications

  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em operações logísticas, last mile, gestão de transportes ou gestão de franquias/parceiros.
  • Perfil Analítico: Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets (tabelas dinâmicas, procv, manipulação de bases). Conhecimento em SQL. Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau ou Metabase) é um diferencial.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de olhar para um número ruim, investigar a causa e propor uma solução prática.
  • Influência e Negociação: Habilidade para cobrar resultados de parceiros terceiros de forma diplomática e parceira, construindo relacionamento de longo prazo.
  • Disponibilidade: O perfil da vaga é majoritariamente externo (visitas). É necessário ter disponibilidade para deslocamento constante dentro da região de atuação.
  • Resiliência: Capacidade de atuar em ambiente de alta pressão e dinamismo (característica do varejo/logística).

EEO Statement

  • Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.

Chacun de nos quelques 20 000 employés sont engagés dans la réussite des projets de nos clients et motivés par une solide culture d’exécution, d'innovation ciblée et de conventions industrielles complexes.

Notre vision est de conduire un réel changement dans le secteur de l’énergie et notre stratégie d'entreprise a toujours été axée sur la réussite de cette vision.

Job Description

Sujet du stage :

Étude des relations entre procédé de mise en forme et performances mécaniques sur matériaux thermoplastiques.

Contexte et objectifs

Le concept de pipeline flexible est envisagé pour des applications de plus en plus exigeantes, notamment en termes de sollicitations mécaniques. Pour répondre à ces exigences, des matériaux polymères thermoplastiques techniques sont mis en œuvre par extrusion dans les unités de fabrication du groupe TechnipFMC.

L’objectif du stage est d’identifier et de quantifier les relations entre les conditions de transformation de ces matériaux et leurs performances mécaniques finales, à travers une approche combinant traitement statistique des données et expérimentation (analyse d’image, caractérisation mécanique).

  • Run product quality audits and walks on a frequent basis to certify product requirements are properly met.
  • Act as a risk assessor for product manufacturing and any risks of execution are properly identified and mitigated.

  • Witness product inspections and processes/product qualification inspections.
  • Ensure critical observations are registered and concerns are properly identified and escalated to the respective levels of the organization.
  • Lead manufacturing review processes for all new first article involving the relevant stakeholders.
  • Be an agent for implementing Non‑Conformance Management process at extended sites.

Required Characteristics

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
  • Fluent English skills.
  • Knowledge in local Brazilian customer quality requirements related to fabrication of subsea equipment including XT, Manifolds and Tooling.
  • Previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
  • Experience in Quality and product requirement audits.
  • Knowledge in product quality inspection and documentation analysis.
  • Experience in quality tools for developing improvement actions (A3, 8D, 5whys, fishbone, FMEA, 5S, Lean Six‑Sigma).

Required Skills

  • Strong leadership skills.
  • Negotiation and influencing skills with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Clear thinker and effective communication.
  • Problem solving skills.

Desired Characteristics

  • Technical product qualification by external parties as Dimensional, Painting, Welding or NDT, Fabrication.

Location : Houston, TX, US Rio de Janeiro, BR

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as equal opportunities, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

The Global Trade Compliance Program Manager at TechnipFMC will lead initiatives to strengthen and optimize the company’s trade compliance program. This role involves managing global projects, driving Lean Transformation objectives, and ensuring the effectiveness of sanctions and export control processes through collaboration with teams worldwide. The position offers significant opportunities to work on strategic, business‑critical initiatives, partnering with operations and business units to maintain a best‑in‑class compliance framework. Ideal candidates will bring strong organizational skills, creativity, and program management expertise, with potential for growth and leadership within a global compliance team committed to upholding TechnipFMC’s core values.

Job Description

  • Lead development and execution of major international trade compliance programs, ensuring alignment with global objectives and operational adherence.
  • Drive accountability for program success by initiating, tracking, and managing detailed project objectives, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Recommend and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, standardization, and simplification across trade compliance operations.
  • Manage and coordinate global sanctions and export compliance processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor and analyze legal developments in international trade compliance, including sanctions, export controls, and customs regulations, and update internal guidance accordingly.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across the organization to achieve programmatic goals and foster collaboration.
  • Lead monthly review meetings to present program results, identify improvement areas, and drive actionable plans for continuous enhancement.
  • Maintain subject matter expertise in program management tools and contribute to system development initiatives supporting industrialization and global compliance standards.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in program / project management.
  • Proficiency with online workflow and organizational tools for tracking project status and deliverables, coupled with advanced Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project).
  • Strong leadership and management capabilities in dynamic, matrixed environments; proven ability to manage global project teams and drive organizational change through collaboration.
  • Expertise in stakeholder engagement, including initiating and leading planning calls, analyzing data independently, and presenting findings in a clear, professional manner.
  • Experience in developing training programs and communication materials, such as newsletters, one‑pagers, and presentations.
  • Ability to work independently under minimal supervision, demonstrating strategic decision‑making, process improvement, and creative problem‑solving in ambiguous situations.
  • Excellent planning, communication, and interpersonal skills, with critical thinking, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to continuous learning in Trade Compliance and program management.

Work Environment

Hybrid schedule (in‑office / remote work). Some international travel, as necessary visiting TFMC regional offices or locations for purposes of executing the Legal Operations and Compliance workload and strategy.

Physical Demands

Frequent sitting and operating a computer. Fast‑paced atmosphere with multiple priorities and constant change. Some travel due to role.

Skills

Leadership Planning
